newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical closes ageing ethylene plant.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical closes ageing ethylene plant.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co said it has closed one of its light hydrocarbon manufacturing facilities.
The facility closed was LHC-6 in Freeport, a 700 million pound per year ethylene manufacturing plant that was first started in 1967.
With the closure of this unit Dow has four light hydrocarbon plants on the Gulf Coast with a total capacity of 5.3 billion pounds per year, it said.
The company said the timing of closure for LHC-6 was influenced by capital requirements to maintain its operation and by options to replace the capacity at its other North American plants.
